title: Will a Top Trump Deputy Flip?

sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 大家好，我是安德鲁·罗斯·索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for Dealbook, a daily newsletter at the New York Times.
sentences.zh: 我为《纽约时报》的每日通讯《Dealbook》报道商业和政策新闻。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市举行的Dealbook峰会上现场采访一些商业、政治和文化领域最具影响力的人物，包括J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine Lagarde, Zilran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the Dealbook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜·拉加德、齐尔兰·蒙达尼等等。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 届时，您可以实时观看其中一些毫无保留、未经修饰的对话。

sentences.en: We're going to be live-streaming select interviews for anyone to watch free at nytimes.com on November 18th.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我们将在nytimes.com上直播部分精选采访，供所有人免费观看。

sentences.en: If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果您还不是订阅用户，可以下载《纽约时报》应用程序进行观看，并获得我们所有新闻内容一个月的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 希望您能准时收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 您一定不想错过。

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: This is a daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Today.
sentences.zh: 今日话题。

sentences.en: Prosecutors in Manhattan are pursuing what many believe may be the best and last chance to hold Donald Trump legally accountable for his conduct as a businessman.
sentences.zh: 曼哈顿的检察官们正在推进一项调查，许多人认为这可能是让唐纳德·特朗普为其商人时期的行为承担法律责任的最好、也是最后的机会。

sentences.en: I spoke with my colleagues, Ben Protest, about the story behind the case and Michael Rothfeld about the Trump loyalist whom prosecutors need to cooperate.
sentences.zh: 我与我的同事本·普罗特斯特谈论了案件背后的故事，并与迈克尔·罗斯菲尔德讨论了检察官需要其配合的特朗普亲信。

sentences.en: Tuesday, July 13th.
sentences.zh: 7月13日，星期二。

sentences.en: Ben, because Donald Trump is no longer president, I think it's safe to say that we all follow the legal and investigatory machinations around him a little less closely.
sentences.zh: 本，因为唐纳德·特朗普已经不再是总统了，我想可以肯定地说，我们对围绕他的法律和调查运作的关注度已经降低了一些。

sentences.en: Maybe not you, because this is your beat.
sentences.zh: 也许你除外，因为这是你的报道领域。

sentences.en: But for the rest of us laypeople, this is all feeling pretty distant.
sentences.zh: 但对于我们这些外行来说，这一切感觉相当遥远。

sentences.en: But then, all of a sudden, there's this indictment a few weeks ago of the company that bears his name, the Trump Organization.
sentences.zh: 然而，几周前，以他名字命名的公司——特朗普集团，突然遭到了起诉。

sentences.en: And I want to know, what is the story behind that case?
sentences.zh: 我想知道，这起案件背后的故事是什么？

sentences.en: Do you remember Stormy Daniels?
sentences.zh: 你还记得斯托米·丹尼尔斯吗？

sentences.en: Stormy!
sentences.zh: 斯托米！

sentences.en: Stephanie Clifford, a porn star who goes by the stage name Stormy Daniels, said she and Donald Trump had sex once in 2006.
sentences.zh: 斯蒂芬妮·克利福德，一位艺名为斯托米·丹尼尔斯的成人电影明星，声称她和唐纳德·特朗普在2006年有过一次性关系。

sentences.en: He's like, wow, you are special.
sentences.zh: 他说，哇，你真特别。

sentences.en: You remind me of my daughter.
sentences.zh: 你让我想起了我的女儿。

sentences.en: After Trump won the Republican nomination, Daniels says Cohen reached out with the now infamous
sentences.zh: 在特朗普赢得共和党提名后，丹尼尔斯说科恩提出了那个现在臭名昭著的

sentences.en: $130,000 offer, which came with a non-disclosure agreement.
sentences.zh: 13万美元的报价，并附带了一份保密协议。

sentences.en: She's the adult film star who said she had an affair with Donald Trump, and she threatened to tell her story on the eve of the presidential election.
sentences.zh: 她就是那位声称与唐纳德·特朗普有染的成人电影明星，她在总统大选前夕威胁要公开她的故事。

sentences.en: And so Trump's fixer, Michael Cohen, at the time, pays her $130,000 to keep quiet and essentially shelve that story.
sentences.zh: 于是，当时特朗普的“清理人”迈克尔·科恩支付了她13万美元，让她保持沉默，基本上把这件事压了下去。

sentences.en: So that payment drew the attention of federal investigators in Manhattan, who were already scrutinizing Cohen.
sentences.zh: 这笔款项引起了曼哈顿联邦调查人员的注意，他们当时已经在审查科恩。

sentences.en: And they conclude that this payment was potentially an illegal campaign violation.
sentences.zh: 他们断定这笔付款可能构成了非法的竞选违规。

sentences.en: It was excessive past what campaign donations are allowed to be, and it was not recorded.
sentences.zh: 这笔钱超过了竞选捐款的允许限额，而且没有记录在案。

sentences.en: But it was majorly impactful of the election, they concluded, and so it was a federal crime.
sentences.zh: 但他们认为这对选举产生了重大影响，因此这是一项联邦罪行。

sentences.en: Cohen pleaded guilty in August to dodging taxes, lying to Congress, and violating campaign finance laws.
sentences.zh: 科恩在8月承认了逃税、向国会撒谎以及违反竞选财务法的罪名。

sentences.en: And ultimately, Cohen pled guilty to that August 2018, as well as a host of other crimes.
sentences.zh: 最终，科恩在2018年8月承认了这些罪名，以及其他一系列罪行。

sentences.en: And he stood up in court and said that he did so at the direction of Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 他在法庭上站出来说，他是受唐纳德·特朗普的指示才这么做的。

sentences.en: And ultimately, a few months later, he had his sentencing.
sentences.zh: 几个月后，他接受了判决。

sentences.en: Michael Cohen is going to jail.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔·科恩要入狱了。

sentences.en: Cohen has just been sentenced.
sentences.zh: 科恩刚刚被判刑。

sentences.en: To three years in prison.
sentences.zh: 判处三年监禁。

sentences.en: The prosecutors confirmed just that very fact.
sentences.zh: 检察官证实了这一事实。

sentences.en: They say that the payment was made for the benefit of and at the direction of Donald J.
sentences.zh: 他们说，这笔付款是为了唐纳德·J·特朗普的利益，并受其指示而支付的。

sentences.en: Trump.
sentences.zh: 特朗普。

sentences.en: And there are rules you can't indict a sitting president.
sentences.zh: 而且有规定，你不能起诉在任总统。

sentences.en: There are various, you know, issues they encountered in terms of proving intent of Donald Trump's knowledge of the campaign finance laws at that time.
sentences.zh: 在证明唐纳德·特朗普当时对竞选财务法知情意图方面，他们遇到了各种各样的问题。

sentences.en: But Michael Cohen was a lawyer.
sentences.zh: 但迈克尔·科恩是一名律师。

sentences.en: Michael Cohen should have known and ultimately pleaded guilty to this.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔·科恩本应知晓，并最终承认了这一点。

sentences.en: Although, you know, no charges were filed against the president at that time, it still implicated him as part of that scandal.
sentences.zh: 虽然当时没有对总统提出指控，但这仍然使他卷入了那场丑闻。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Implicated him, but couldn't really touch him.
sentences.zh: 卷入其中，但无法真正触及他。

sentences.en: And I remember thinking like, well, that's that.
sentences.zh: 我记得当时想，好吧，就这样了。

sentences.en: The feds have gotten Michael Cohen, but not Trump.
sentences.zh: 联邦调查局抓住了迈克尔·科恩，但没能抓住特朗普。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And the feds continued to investigate his company because it wasn't just Michael Cohen acting as a rogue agent, or at least that's not what the feds thought.
sentences.zh: 联邦调查局继续调查他的公司，因为他们认为这不仅仅是迈克尔·科恩个人的越权行为，或者至少联邦调查局不是这么想的。

sentences.en: The feds came to believe that Donald Trump and some people in his company were involved in these payments, perhaps even directed them.
sentences.zh: 联邦调查局开始相信，唐纳德·特朗普和他公司的一些人参与了这些付款，甚至可能直接指挥了这些付款。

sentences.en: But believing something and proving something are two very different things.
sentences.zh: 但相信某事和证明某事是两码事。

sentences.en: And so despite, you know, digging and interviewing various witnesses and doing what they could to prove the Trump organization and Mr. Trump's involvement in the hush money,
sentences.zh: 尽管他们进行了挖掘、采访了各种证人，并尽其所能证明特朗普集团和特朗普先生参与了封口费事件，

sentences.en: they ultimately wound down their case in July of 2019.
sentences.zh: 他们最终还是在2019年7月结束了调查。

sentences.en: Mr. Trump was not accused of any wrongdoing.
sentences.zh: 特朗普先生没有被指控有任何不当行为。

sentences.en: Donald Trump essentially is able to argue that this was the actions of Michael Cohen and Michael Cohen only, who he described as a rat and as somebody who was disloyal to him.
sentences.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普基本上能够辩称，这是迈克尔·科恩一个人的行为，他称科恩为“老鼠”，是一个对他不忠的人。

sentences.en: And he was able to basically brush it off as overzealous prosecutors targeting somebody who he was no longer aligned with.
sentences.zh: 他能够将其轻描淡写地归咎于过度热心的检察官，针对的是一个他不再与之结盟的人。

sentences.en: So what happens next?
sentences.zh: 那么接下来会发生什么？

sentences.en: How do we end up getting to where we are now?
sentences.zh: 我们是如何走到今天这一步的？

sentences.en: So as the federal investigation wound down, you have just a few blocks away, Cy Vance, the DA in Manhattan, keeping a very close eye on all of this.
sentences.zh: 随着联邦调查的结束，就在几个街区之外，曼哈顿地区检察官赛·万斯一直在密切关注这一切。

sentences.en: And pretty soon after the investigation wound down in the federal sphere, you have Mr. Vance's office issuing some subpoenas.
sentences.zh: 在联邦层面的调查结束后不久，万斯先生的办公室就发出了一些传票。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: As far as we can tell, Vance's office wanted to tell whether or not there was a sort of improper effort to deduct the hush money payments as legal expenses from their tax returns.
sentences.zh: 据我们所知，万斯办公室想查明是否存在将封口费作为法律费用从纳税申报表中扣除的不当行为。

sentences.en: So they needed to look into the tax returns themselves and see what was in there.
sentences.zh: 所以他们需要查看纳税申报表本身，看看里面有什么。

sentences.en: Now, I think they started to get a sense that if they opened up that Pandora's box, they might be able to see other things as well.
sentences.zh: 我想他们开始意识到，如果打开这个潘多拉魔盒，他们可能还会发现其他东西。

sentences.en: And so they didn't just ask for one or two years of tax returns.
sentences.zh: 所以他们不仅仅要求提供一两年的纳税申报表。

sentences.en: They asked for eight years of tax returns.
sentences.zh: 他们要求提供八年的纳税申报表。

sentences.en: So Trump's lawyers sue and they say, absolutely not.
sentences.zh: 于是特朗普的律师提起诉讼，他们说，绝对不行。

sentences.en: We're not turning that over.
sentences.zh: 我们不会交出这些资料。

sentences.en: We're not having our accountants turn that over.
sentences.zh: 我们不会让我们的会计师交出这些资料。

sentences.en: And this case basically works its way to the courts and Trump keeps losing at every level until it reaches the Supreme Court.
sentences.zh: 这个案子基本上一直打到了法院，特朗普在每一级都在输，直到打到最高法院。

sentences.en: The fight over Donald Trump's tax returns hitting the Supreme Court in a historic standoff.
sentences.zh: 关于唐纳德·特朗普纳税申报表的争斗进入了最高法院，陷入了历史性的僵局。

sentences.en: Where he, once again, in a very consequential opinion.
sentences.zh: 在那里，他再次遭遇了一项非常重要的裁决。

sentences.en: We have breaking news coming in right now from the U.S.
sentences.zh: 我们刚刚收到来自美国最高法院的突发新闻。

sentences.en: Supreme Court.
sentences.zh: 最高法院。

sentences.en: Loses again.
sentences.zh: 他又输了。

sentences.en: Which just decided that a New York prosecutor can get the financial records of President Trump.
sentences.zh: 最高法院刚刚裁定，纽约检察官可以获得特朗普总统的财务记录。

sentences.en: So effectively, after some delay.
sentences.zh: 所以实际上，在经过一些拖延之后。

sentences.en: After an 18-month court battle, prosecutors investigating former President Trump for possible fraud have obtained his tax and financial records.
sentences.zh: 经过18个月的法庭斗争，调查前总统特朗普可能存在欺诈行为的检察官已经获得了他的税务和财务记录。

sentences.en: The DA's office gets those records and that is just a major turning point in the investigation.
sentences.zh: 地区检察官办公室拿到了这些记录，这是调查的一个重大转折点。

sentences.en: And so what does the district attorney of Manhattan, Cy Vance,
sentences.zh: 那么曼哈顿地区检察官赛·万斯，

sentences.en: what does he and his team find once they have the Supreme Court ruling and suddenly eight years of the president's tax documents in their hands?
sentences.zh: 他和他的团队在得到最高法院的裁决，手中突然掌握了总统八年的税务文件后，发现了什么？

sentences.en: So the DA's office seems to identify a few potential issues.
sentences.zh: 地区检察官办公室似乎发现了一些潜在的问题。

sentences.en: One is that there seems to be a concern that the president's company essentially keeps two separate sets of books.
sentences.zh: 一个是人们担心总统的公司基本上保留了两套账本。

sentences.en: One set of books for his lenders and another set of books for the tax authorities.
sentences.zh: 一套账本给贷款人看，另一套账本给税务机关看。

sentences.en: Explain that.
sentences.zh: 解释一下。

sentences.en: So in the lender's set of books, you get a glowing picture of the president's finances.
sentences.zh: 在给贷款人的账本中，总统的财务状况看起来非常光鲜。

sentences.en: And it's everything you would want to see from a potential client that you would want to lend to.
sentences.zh: 这是你作为潜在贷款方希望从潜在客户那里看到的一切。

sentences.en: They're in great financial shape.
sentences.zh: 他们的财务状况非常好。

sentences.en: They are a company that's very worthy of getting loans.
sentences.zh: 他们是一家非常值得贷款的公司。

sentences.en: And then to the tax authorities, they paint a different picture.
sentences.zh: 然后给税务机关看的时候，他们描绘了另一幅图景。

sentences.en: A company that has some financial issues and that does not have full occupancy in its buildings.
sentences.zh: 一家财务状况有些问题，且建筑物入住率不满的公司。

sentences.en: And this contrast between what was told to the lenders, what was told to the tax authorities, raises some eyebrows.
sentences.zh: 这种给贷款人的说法与给税务机关的说法之间的对比，引起了一些怀疑。

sentences.en: And so that's one area of interest for them.
sentences.zh: 所以这是他们感兴趣的一个领域。

sentences.en: But then they also seem to identify this separate issue,
sentences.zh: 但他们似乎还发现了另一个独立的问题，

sentences.en: which is that the company seems to have been paying out perks and bonuses and various luxury items to some of its top executives totally off the books.
sentences.zh: 那就是该公司似乎一直在向其一些高管发放完全不入账的津贴、奖金和各种奢侈品。

sentences.en: And as they identify this and sort of unspool that, that leads them to this potentially vast, as they describe it,
sentences.zh: 当他们发现这一点并将其理清时，这引导他们发现了他们所描述的潜在的、巨大的，

sentences.en: 15-year scheme to defraud the government out of getting tax income.
sentences.zh: 长达15年的欺诈政府税收收入的计划。

sentences.en: Okay, so after the DA finds what may be financial fraud, telling lenders one thing, which is very rosy, telling tax authorities another, which is very dire,
sentences.zh: 好的，那么在地区检察官发现可能存在的金融欺诈——告诉贷款人一套非常乐观的情况，告诉税务机关另一套非常糟糕的情况之后，

sentences.en: and after finding what may be tax fraud in the form of these untaxed executive perks, what does the DA do with these discoveries?
sentences.zh: 在发现了以这些未纳税的高管津贴形式存在的税务欺诈之后，地区检察官对这些发现做了什么？

sentences.en: How does he act on them?
sentences.zh: 他是如何根据这些发现采取行动的？

sentences.en: He acts by zeroing in on the Trump organization's longtime CFO, Alan Weisselberg.
sentences.zh: 他的行动重点是特朗普集团的长期首席财务官艾伦·魏塞尔伯格。

sentences.en: He really drilled down on Mr. Weisselberg's perks and everything that Mr. Weisselberg had been receiving from the company over the years.
sentences.zh: 他深入调查了魏塞尔伯格先生的津贴，以及魏塞尔伯格先生多年来从公司获得的一切。

sentences.en: And that included Mercedes-Benz's.
sentences.zh: 这包括梅赛德斯-奔驰汽车。

sentences.en: That included a rent-free apartment in the west side of Manhattan.
sentences.zh: 这包括曼哈顿西区一套免租金的公寓。

sentences.en: That included tuition for his grandchildren at a prep school in Manhattan.
sentences.zh: 这包括他孙辈在曼哈顿预科学校的学费。

sentences.en: So these were things that immediately caught their attention, it seeMs.
sentences.zh: 看来这些事情立刻引起了他们的注意。

sentences.en: Why, though?
sentences.zh: 但为什么呢？

sentences.en: I mean, what's wrong with a generous boss?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，有一个慷慨的老板有什么错吗？

sentences.en: There's nothing wrong with a generous boss.
sentences.zh: 有一个慷慨的老板并没有错。

sentences.en: You just got to record it on the books as compensation.
sentences.zh: 你只需要把它作为薪酬记录在账本上就行了。

sentences.en: And you can give people company cars.
sentences.zh: 你可以给员工提供公司用车。

sentences.en: You can give them apartments.
sentences.zh: 你可以给他们提供公寓。

sentences.en: You can even pay tuition.
sentences.zh: 你甚至可以支付学费。

sentences.en: But the problem is you have to tell the IRS and you have to tell New York State that these are perks that you're giving so that everyone pays the taxes on it.
sentences.zh: 但问题是你必须告诉美国国税局，也必须告诉纽约州，这些是你提供的津贴，这样每个人都要为此纳税。

sentences.en: Ultimately,
sentences.zh: 最终，

sentences.en: they concluded that Mr. Weisselberg had about $1.7 million in perks that he received and bonuses and fringe benefits that he received that were never reported to the tax authorities,
sentences.zh: 他们断定魏塞尔伯格先生收到了大约170万美元的津贴、奖金和附加福利，这些从未向税务机关申报，

sentences.en: which means he owed the IRS, he owed the state, he owed the city nearly a million dollars.
sentences.zh: 这意味着他欠美国国税局、州政府和市政府近一百万美元。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: A dramatic legal moment unfolding in front of the cameras here in New York.
sentences.zh: 在纽约的摄像机前，上演了戏剧性的一幕。

sentences.en: CFO Alan Weisselberg arriving in court in handcuffs.
sentences.zh: 首席财务官艾伦·魏塞尔伯格戴着手铐抵达法庭。

sentences.en: So that's ultimately what the district attorney's office decided to indict Mr. Weisselberg for.
sentences.zh: 这就是地区检察官办公室最终决定起诉魏塞尔伯格先生的原因。

sentences.en: He and the former president's business empire were charged in what prosecutors today called a sweeping and audacious scheme to avoid paying taxes.
sentences.zh: 他和这位前总统的商业帝国被指控参与了检察官今天所称的“大规模且大胆的逃税计划”。

sentences.en: The DA also indicts the Trump Organization and accuses the Trump Organization of conspiring with Mr. Weisselberg to participate in the scheme.
sentences.zh: 地区检察官还起诉了特朗普集团，指控特朗普集团与魏塞尔伯格先生合谋参与该计划。

sentences.en: And not just enabling his scheme, but itself avoiding some of the taxes it would have had to pay.
sentences.zh: 而且不仅仅是促成了他的计划，公司本身也逃避了一些本应缴纳的税款。

sentences.en: And lawyers say they have the receipts, 15 years worth of digital drives, bookkeeping records, tax records, witness statements, and more.
sentences.zh: 律师们说他们有收据，包括15年的数字驱动器、簿记记录、税务记录、证人陈述等等。

sentences.en: So this is something that they basically argue went back to 2005 and are reaching back all the way into that period.
sentences.zh: 所以他们基本上认为这可以追溯到2005年，一直延伸到那个时期。

sentences.en: But Ben, here again, we seem to have a case where prosecutors, first it was federal prosecutors, now it's city prosecutors, have made a case against an underling of Donald Trump,
sentences.zh: 但是本，这里我们似乎又遇到了一个情况，检察官——先是联邦检察官，现在是市检察官——已经对唐纳德·特朗普的下属提起了诉讼，

sentences.en: but do not seem to be able to prove anything against Trump himself.
sentences.zh: 但似乎无法证明特朗普本人有任何罪行。

sentences.en: At this point, so this is a key moment in the investigation, and this is how these investigations work.
sentences.zh: 在这一点上，这是调查的关键时刻，这就是这些调查的工作方式。

sentences.en: You start with someone lower on the totem pole.
sentences.zh: 你从权力阶梯较低的人开始。

sentences.en: And keep in mind that Allen Weisselberg is not low.
sentences.zh: 请记住，艾伦·魏塞尔伯格的地位并不低。

sentences.en: He is the CFO of the company.
sentences.zh: 他是公司的首席财务官。

sentences.en: He's a senior level executive.
sentences.zh: 他是高级管理人员。

sentences.en: He helped run the company.
sentences.zh: 他帮助管理公司。

sentences.en: Mr. Trump was in the White House.
sentences.zh: 特朗普先生当时在白宫。

sentences.en: So the step here is to indict Weisselberg and indict the company and put them on the defensive and ultimately squeeze Weisselberg as hard as possible to cooperate against Trump.
sentences.zh: 所以这一步是起诉魏塞尔伯格和公司，让他们处于防御状态，并最终尽可能地向魏塞尔伯格施压，让他配合调查特朗普。

sentences.en: So going after Weisselberg is really about going after Trump, but on what charges?
sentences.zh: 所以针对魏塞尔伯格实际上是为了针对特朗普，但以什么罪名呢？

sentences.en: What are they trying to get Weisselberg to implicate Trump as having done?
sentences.zh: 他们试图让魏塞尔伯格指控特朗普做了什么？

sentences.en: There are at least two avenues that they can pursue.
sentences.zh: 他们至少可以采取两条途径。

sentences.en: One is these sort of two sets of books, what Trump told his lenders versus what he told the local tax authorities.
sentences.zh: 一是那两套账本，即特朗普告诉贷款人的情况与他告诉地方税务机关的情况之间的差异。

sentences.en: And then there's this track of what did Trump know about all these perks and bonuses that were handed out.
sentences.zh: 二是关于特朗普对所有这些发放的津贴和奖金知情程度的调查。

sentences.en: And for all we know, there's other avenues that they're pursuing as well.
sentences.zh: 据我们所知，他们也在寻求其他途径。

sentences.en: But even if you just take those two, without Allen Weisselberg, it's very hard to prove that Donald Trump knew he was breaking the law.
sentences.zh: 但即使只看这两点，如果没有艾伦·魏塞尔伯格，就很难证明唐纳德·特朗普知道自己在违法。

sentences.en: Why?
sentences.zh: 为什么？

sentences.en: Explain that.
sentences.zh: 解释一下。

sentences.en: Donald Trump doesn't use email.
sentences.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普从不使用电子邮件。

sentences.en: It's very unlikely that there's any kind of written record of Donald Trump instructing lower level employees to break the law.
sentences.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普指示下属违法，并留下任何书面记录的可能性非常小。

sentences.en: You need somebody who was in the room with him to narrate what happened.
sentences.zh: 你需要一个当时在场的人来讲述发生了什么。

sentences.en: This all comes down to intent and willfulness and whether or not Donald Trump knew he was playing fast and loose and knew he was breaking the law.
sentences.zh: 这一切归根结底在于意图和蓄意，以及唐纳德·特朗普是否知道自己在打擦边球，是否知道自己在违法。

sentences.en: And it's very hard to prove that without any kind of cooperating witness.
sentences.zh: 如果没有某种污点证人，这一点很难证明。

sentences.en: I'm not saying it's impossible.
sentences.zh: 我并不是说这不可能。

sentences.en: I'm saying it's very hard.
sentences.zh: 我是说这非常困难。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So for this case to work, for there to be any chance after all these investigations and all these years of subpoenas and record scouring,
sentences.zh: 所以，要让这个案子成立，要在经历了这么多调查、这么多年的传票和记录搜查之后还有任何机会，

sentences.en: these prosecutors need Allen Weisselberg to basically flip.
sentences.zh: 这些检察官需要艾伦·魏塞尔伯格基本上倒戈。

sentences.en: They need somebody to flip on Trump and be the person who was in the room, who knew what he was doing, knew what he was saying and knew what he was thinking.
sentences.zh: 他们需要有人背叛特朗普，成为那个在场的人，知道他在做什么、说了什么、想了什么。

sentences.en: They need, as Trump would say, a rap.
sentences.zh: 他们需要一个用特朗普的话说就是“告密者”的人。

sentences.en: After the break, I speak with my colleague Michael Rothfeld about Allen Weisselberg.
sentences.zh: 休息过后，我将与我的同事迈克尔·罗斯菲尔德谈谈艾伦·魏塞尔伯格。

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》应用程序？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 解锁版？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to the Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 大家都知道，你需要订阅《纽约时报》才能阅读所有报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore the Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但如果能免费试用《纽约时报》一个月，且无需输入信用卡信息呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: When you download the New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当你首次下载《纽约时报》应用程序时，第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 用一个月的时间突破付费墙，看看《纽约时报》订阅者每天都能获得什么。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to the New York Times, download the Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你还没有订阅《纽约时报》，今天就下载应用程序，免费获取30天的访问权限。

sentences.en: Michael, our colleague Ben Protis just told us that the DA's larger case against former President Trump really hinges on this one executive, Allen Weisselberg,
sentences.zh: 迈克尔，我们的同事本·普罗蒂斯刚刚告诉我们，地方检察官针对前总统特朗普的大规模案件，实际上取决于这位高管——艾伦·魏塞尔伯格，

sentences.en: and whether he will cooperate with prosecutors.
sentences.zh: 以及他是否会与检察官合作。

sentences.en: So what should we know about Weisselberg to understand that?
sentences.zh: 那么，为了理解这一点，我们应该了解魏塞尔伯格的什么情况？

sentences.en: How did he become Trump's money man?
sentences.zh: 他是如何成为特朗普的“钱袋子”的？

sentences.en: Allen Weisselberg is a guy who has been around the Trump Organization basically as long as anyone.
sentences.zh: 艾伦·魏塞尔伯格在特朗普集团待的时间基本上和任何人一样长。

sentences.en: He comes from a pretty humble background.
sentences.zh: 他的出身相当卑微。

sentences.en: I mean, he grew up deep in Brooklyn and went to high school in East New York and went to Pace College and graduated with a degree in accounting
sentences.zh: 我是说，他在布鲁克林深处长大，在东纽约读的高中，后来去了佩斯学院，毕业时获得了会计学位，

sentences.en: and then worked as a teacher for a little bit in some small financial firms before he went to work for Fred Trump, who was a prominent developer in Brooklyn and Queens at the time.
sentences.zh: 之后在几家小型金融公司当过一段时间的老师，然后才去为弗雷德·特朗普工作，弗雷德当时是布鲁克林和皇后区的一位著名开发商。

sentences.en: And through working for Fred, he met Donald.
sentences.zh: 通过为弗雷德工作，他认识了唐纳德。

sentences.en: And at the time, Donald Trump is a young, ambitious guy who's looking to move into Manhattan and start making his name there.
sentences.zh: 当时的唐纳德·特朗普是一个年轻、雄心勃勃的人，正寻求进入曼哈顿并开始在那里打响名声。

sentences.en: And Allen Weisselberg makes a connection to him and he goes to work for Donald Trump on nights and weekends while still working for Fred Trump during the day.
sentences.zh: 艾伦·魏塞尔伯格与他建立了联系，并在白天继续为弗雷德·特朗普工作的同时，利用晚上和周末为唐纳德·特朗普工作。

sentences.en: And sort of over time, moved over and went to work for Donald Trump full time in 1986 and has been there ever since.
sentences.zh: 随着时间的推移，他在1986年转为全职为唐纳德·特朗普工作，并一直待在那里。

sentences.en: And what exactly does he do for Donald Trump?
sentences.zh: 他到底为唐纳德·特朗普做什么？

sentences.en: Anything involving money, Allen Weisselberg has his fingers in.
sentences.zh: 任何涉及金钱的事情，艾伦·魏塞尔伯格都插手其中。

sentences.en: I mean, his main function is to just watch the dollars and cents and, you know, just keeping track of where everything is.
sentences.zh: 我是说，他的主要职能就是盯着每一分钱，你知道的，就是追踪每一笔钱的去向。

sentences.en: He does get involved in other things like tax returns and financing deals.
sentences.zh: 他也参与其他事务，比如纳税申报和融资交易。

sentences.en: He established an accounting department there.
sentences.zh: 他在那里建立了一个会计部门。

sentences.en: But one thing that people told us is that Allen Weisselberg really specialized in preventing vendors from charging any more than they could and just delaying payment as long as possible.
sentences.zh: 但人们告诉我们的一件事是，艾伦·魏塞尔伯格真正擅长的是防止供应商收取超出他们应得的费用，并尽可能地拖延付款。

sentences.en: So if the Trump organization hires a law firm or any other kind of vendor, he would delay as long as possible.
sentences.zh: 所以，如果特朗普集团聘请了一家律师事务所或任何其他类型的供应商，他会尽可能地拖延。

sentences.en: And then, you know, if there's any way to knock anything off the bill, Weisselberg would find a way to do that.
sentences.zh: 然后，你知道的，如果有什么办法能从账单上扣掉一点钱，魏塞尔伯格总能找到办法。

sentences.en: And that's something that Donald Trump asked of a lot of employees.
sentences.zh: 这是唐纳德·特朗普对许多员工的要求。

sentences.en: But Weisselberg is in charge of the money.
sentences.zh: 但魏塞尔伯格负责管钱。

sentences.en: So really is sort of the top guy for that.
sentences.zh: 所以他确实算是这方面的头号人物。

sentences.en: So a kind of financial enforcer who tracks every penny and tries to save every penny.
sentences.zh: 所以他是一个追踪每一分钱并试图节省每一分钱的财务执行者？

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And he's also involved in Donald Trump's personal finances.
sentences.zh: 他也参与了唐纳德·特朗普的个人财务。

sentences.en: He had helped with the tax returns.
sentences.zh: 他曾协助处理纳税申报单。

sentences.en: And like when the Stormy Daniels payment was done, he certainly would have been involved if Donald Trump had committed to making the payment and agreed to make the payment,
sentences.zh: 比如支付给斯托米·丹尼尔斯的款项，如果唐纳德·特朗普承诺并同意支付，他肯定会参与其中，

sentences.en: which is a point of dispute.
sentences.zh: 这一点是有争议的。

sentences.en: So Weisselberg is pretty much enmeshed with all of Donald Trump's finances.
sentences.zh: 所以魏塞尔伯格几乎与唐纳德·特朗普的所有财务状况都纠缠在一起。

sentences.en: And in fact, because the Trump organization is Donald Trump's personal company, in a way, it all sort of bleeds together.
sentences.zh: 事实上，因为特朗普集团在某种程度上是唐纳德·特朗普的个人公司，这一切都混在一起了。

sentences.en: And Weisselberg is just woven into the fabric of this company and into Donald Trump's personal finances as well.
sentences.zh: 魏塞尔伯格不仅融入了这家公司的结构，也融入了唐纳德·特朗普的个人财务中。

sentences.en: So in Allen Weisselberg, Trump has a pretty loyal executive, maybe somebody cut out of a familiar cloth when it comes to the Trump orbit, right?
sentences.zh: 所以，在艾伦·魏塞尔伯格身上，特朗普拥有了一位相当忠诚的高管，也许在特朗普的圈子里，他就是那种常见的人，对吧？

sentences.en: Somebody who is willing to do what has to be done to please the boss.
sentences.zh: 一个愿意为了取悦老板而做任何必要之事的人。

sentences.en: That's exactly right.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: And Donald Trump has looked for people like that throughout his entire business career.
sentences.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普在他的整个商业生涯中一直在寻找这样的人。

sentences.en: He's looked for people who are willing to cross lines for him and in a way to insulate himself and become fixers like Michael Cohen was.
sentences.zh: 他寻找那些愿意为他越界的人，以某种方式保护自己，并成为像迈克尔·科恩那样的“清道夫”。

sentences.en: And, you know, in Allen Weisselberg, he found a kind of a financial fixer.
sentences.zh: 你知道，在艾伦·魏塞尔伯格身上，他找到了一种财务上的“清道夫”。

sentences.en: So, you know, people have told us when we were reporting on Weisselberg, you know, that Weisselberg would basically do anything that Trump asked.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，我们在报道魏塞尔伯格时，人们告诉我们，魏塞尔伯格基本上会做特朗普要求的任何事情。

sentences.en: He was pretty much available to whatever the boss's whim was and that when good things would happen, he would run in and, you know, let Trump know immediately.
sentences.zh: 他几乎随时待命，以满足老板的任何突发奇想；当有好事发生时，他会跑去第一时间告诉特朗普。

sentences.en: And when you'd walk in, if you're a Trump Organization employee into Donald Trump's office, you'd often find Allen Weisselberg already there,
sentences.zh: 当你作为特朗普集团的员工走进唐纳德·特朗普的办公室时，你经常会发现艾伦·魏塞尔伯格已经在那里了，

sentences.en: seated in the chair to the right in front of Donald Trump's desk.
sentences.zh: 坐在唐纳德·特朗普办公桌前右侧的椅子上。

sentences.en: He'd be in the office late at night.
sentences.zh: 他会深夜待在办公室里。

sentences.en: When you left, he'd be there early in the morning when you came in.
sentences.zh: 当你离开时他在那儿，当你早上来上班时他也在那儿。

sentences.en: He has said he never takes a vacation.
sentences.zh: 他说他从不休假。

sentences.en: He's working all the time, nights and weekends.
sentences.zh: 他一直在工作，晚上和周末都在工作。

sentences.en: He was just, you know, a steadfast presence and was available for whatever Donald Trump wanted.
sentences.zh: 他只是，你知道，一个坚定不移的存在，随时准备为唐纳德·特朗普做任何事。

sentences.en: And why do we think that is?
sentences.zh: 我们为什么会这么认为？

sentences.en: I mean, why was he willing to do almost anything for Trump?
sentences.zh: 我是说，他为什么愿意为特朗普做几乎任何事？

sentences.en: Well, a lot of the people that Trump found that were willing to do this for him sort of came from backgrounds that were not too glamorous, right?
sentences.zh: 嗯，特朗普发现的许多愿意为他做这些事的人，背景都不太光鲜，对吧？

sentences.en: Like Michael Cohen grew up in suburban Long Island.
sentences.zh: 比如迈克尔·科恩是在长岛郊区长大的。

sentences.en: You know, Weisselberg grew up in sort of deep into Brooklyn.
sentences.zh: 你知道，魏塞尔伯格是在布鲁克林深处长大的。

sentences.en: And these people encounter Trump and then they're just enamored of sort of the glow of this glamorous guy who's in the tabloids with beautiful women and is building these glittering skyscrapers.
sentences.zh: 这些人遇到了特朗普，然后就被这个出现在小报上、身边美女环绕、建造着闪闪发光的摩天大楼的迷人男子的光环所吸引。

sentences.en: And replacing George this week is my chief financial officer, Allen Weisselberg.
sentences.zh: 本周接替乔治的是我的首席财务官，艾伦·魏塞尔伯格。

sentences.en: And you think George is tough?
sentences.zh: 你觉得乔治很强硬？

sentences.en: Wait till you see Allen.
sentences.zh: 等着瞧瞧艾伦吧。

sentences.en: Allen Weisselberg even shows up on The Apprentice, Donald Trump's reality show, and he makes a cameo.
sentences.zh: 艾伦·魏塞尔伯格甚至出现在了唐纳德·特朗普的真人秀节目《学徒》中，并客串了一把。

sentences.en: Allen?
sentences.zh: 艾伦？

sentences.en: I felt that Andy losing his lines of communication was a very serious matter.
sentences.zh: 我觉得安迪失去沟通渠道是一件非常严重的事情。

sentences.en: If this was a military maneuver and he lost his line of communication, he could lose an entire battalion.
sentences.zh: 如果这是一场军事演习，他失去了沟通渠道，他可能会损失整个营。

sentences.en: I mean, that's just not something that you would ever think would happen if you're a guy growing up in Brownsville in East New York.
sentences.zh: 我是说，如果你是一个在东纽约布朗斯维尔长大的孩子，你根本不会想到会发生这种事。

sentences.en: You have to find a way to communicate with your CEO or leader and convince him or her that a change is necessary.
sentences.zh: 你必须找到一种方法与你的首席执行官或领导沟通，并说服他或她改变是必要的。

sentences.en: I agree with you.
sentences.zh: 我同意你的看法。

sentences.en: And to stay in the path of destruction doesn't work.
sentences.zh: 而且停留在毁灭的道路上是行不通的。

sentences.en: I agree with you.
sentences.zh: 我同意你的看法。

sentences.en: Money guys inside real estate firms generally don't end up starring in primetime reality teachers.
sentences.zh: 房地产公司内部的管钱人通常不会成为黄金时段真人秀的主角。

sentences.en: No, not usually.
sentences.zh: 不，通常不会。

sentences.en: So, I mean, that's just the kind of thing that you can see that would have appealed to Allen Weisselberg basking in the glow of Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 所以，我是说，这就是那种你可以看出会吸引艾伦·魏塞尔伯格沉浸在唐纳德·特朗普光环中的原因。

sentences.en: And Trump takes advantage of that and finds people who are just so happy that he has taken them into his circle that they are just willing to do whatever he asks.
sentences.zh: 特朗普利用了这一点，找到了那些因为被他纳入圈子而感到无比高兴的人，以至于他们愿意做他要求的任何事情。

sentences.en: So, how do the perks that Ben talked to us about that have come up in this indictment, the free cars, apartment, tuition,
sentences.zh: 那么，本向我们提到的这份起诉书中出现的福利，比如免费汽车、公寓、学费，

sentences.en: those would seem to further strengthen whatever loyalty Weisselberg has to Trump and maybe deepen that enamoredness?
sentences.zh: 这些似乎进一步加强了魏塞尔伯格对特朗普的忠诚，并可能加深了那种迷恋？

sentences.en: That's absolutely right.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: And so, as Weisselberg gets more enmeshed in Trump's finances and perhaps does things that Donald Trump really needs,
sentences.zh: 所以，随着魏塞尔伯格越来越深地卷入特朗普的财务状况，并可能做一些唐纳德·特朗普真正需要的事情，

sentences.en: Trump then cements his loyalty by giving him all of these perks, these fringe benefits, and also pays him incredibly well.
sentences.zh: 特朗普通过提供所有这些福利、这些额外津贴，并给他极高的薪水来巩固他的忠诚。

sentences.en: I mean, for like a decade, Allen Weisselberg was earning an average of $800,000 a year in total pay.
sentences.zh: 我是说，有十年时间，艾伦·魏塞尔伯格的平均年薪总额为80万美元。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: And a couple years ago, his pay was almost a million dollars, his total compensation.
sentences.zh: 几年前，他的薪水总额几乎达到了一百万美元。

sentences.en: Okay, so that I think naturally brings us to the question of cooperation,
sentences.zh: 好的，所以我认为这自然引出了合作的问题，

sentences.en: the essential question of whether Allen Weisselberg will be willing to work with the district attorney's office against Trump.
sentences.zh: 即艾伦·魏塞尔伯格是否愿意与地方检察官办公室合作指控特朗普这一核心问题。

sentences.en: And everything you've just laid out, Michael, is a portrait of somebody who would be pretty reluctant to turn on his very generous longtime boss.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔，你刚才列出的一切，描绘了一个非常不愿意背叛他那位慷慨的老板的人。

sentences.en: But we haven't talked about the prosecution's case against Weisselberg and the pressure that he's going to face to flip because of that.
sentences.zh: 但我们还没有谈到检方对魏塞尔伯格的指控，以及他因此将面临的倒戈压力。

sentences.en: So how should we think about that?
sentences.zh: 那么我们应该如何看待这一点？

sentences.en: Well, it's a very complicated question, and you really can never tell who is going to flip and who isn't going to flip.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这是一个非常复杂的问题，你永远无法判断谁会倒戈，谁不会。

sentences.en: With Weisselberg, you have these factors that bind him to Trump, right?
sentences.zh: 对于魏塞尔伯格，你有这些将他与特朗普捆绑在一起的因素，对吧？

sentences.en: Like his 50 years of service to the Trump family, the fact that his own family is involved in Trump.
sentences.zh: 比如他为特朗普家族服务了50年，以及他自己的家人也卷入了特朗普的生意。

sentences.en: They fly down to Florida on the Trump jet to their house near Mar-a-Lago.
sentences.zh: 他们乘坐特朗普的私人飞机飞往佛罗里达，去他们在海湖庄园附近的房子。

sentences.en: All of these things really tie Allen Weisselberg closely to Trump, and he's so well paid.
sentences.zh: 所有这些都确实将艾伦·魏塞尔伯格与特朗普紧密联系在一起，而且他薪水很高。

sentences.en: On the other hand, Allen Weisselberg is 73 years old, right?
sentences.zh: 另一方面，艾伦·魏塞尔伯格已经73岁了，对吧？

sentences.en: He's facing possible prison time, and he theoretically, if he gets convicted, has to pay all these taxes that the government says that he owes.
sentences.zh: 他面临着可能的牢狱之灾，而且理论上，如果他被定罪，他必须支付政府声称他欠下的所有税款。

sentences.en: And those are really complicated issues to weigh.
sentences.zh: 这些都是非常复杂的问题，需要权衡。

sentences.en: Well, what kind of prison time is Weisselberg facing?
sentences.zh: 那么，魏塞尔伯格面临什么样的牢狱之灾？

sentences.en: Because that would seem to be key to understanding his deliberations here.
sentences.zh: 因为这似乎是理解他在此处权衡的关键。

sentences.en: Yeah, that's going to be a huge factor in how he decides to proceed.
sentences.zh: 是的，这将是他决定如何行事的一个巨大因素。

sentences.en: So the most serious count, grand larceny, could carry up to 15 years in prison.
sentences.zh: 所以最严重的指控，重大盗窃罪，可能导致最高15年的监禁。

sentences.en: That is a pretty extreme and unlikely scenario.
sentences.zh: 那是一个相当极端且不太可能的情况。

sentences.en: People have told us, experts, that with most of these charges, it could be as low as probation.
sentences.zh: 专家告诉我们，对于大多数这些指控，刑期可能低至缓刑。

sentences.en: He has no previous criminal record, and that would definitely carry weight with a judge.
sentences.zh: 他没有犯罪记录，这肯定会在法官面前产生影响。

sentences.en: Or it could be one or two years in prison, and then you get some time off for good behavior.
sentences.zh: 或者可能是一到两年的监禁，然后因为表现良好而减刑。

sentences.en: You know, he might decide that he can handle that at this point in his life.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他可能会认为他在人生的这个阶段可以应付这一点。

sentences.en: You know, maybe after he gets out of prison, he will be rewarded for his loyalty.
sentences.zh: 你知道，也许在他出狱后，他会因为他的忠诚而得到奖励。

sentences.en: Maybe Donald Trump gives him a huge bonus or finds some other way to compensate him for all of the time that he served in jail.
sentences.zh: 也许唐纳德·特朗普会给他一大笔奖金，或者找到其他方式来补偿他服刑期间的损失。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: So Weisselberg's choices seem to be, one, don't cooperate, and maybe beat the charges and win Trump's affections and maybe reap even more financial rewards.
sentences.zh: 所以魏塞尔伯格的选择似乎是：第一，不合作，也许能打赢官司，赢得特朗普的青睐，甚至可能获得更多的经济回报。

sentences.en: Or cooperate and ensure no jail time and freedom, but almost assuredly incur Donald Trump's wrath, which can be very meaningful.
sentences.zh: 或者合作，确保不坐牢并获得自由，但几乎肯定会招致唐纳德·特朗普的愤怒，这可能非常严重。

sentences.en: Yeah, turning against Donald Trump can be a pretty scary thing.
sentences.zh: 是的，背叛唐纳德·特朗普可能是一件非常可怕的事情。

sentences.en: This is a guy who is willing to go after pretty much anyone who crosses him in a really sort of vicious way.
sentences.zh: 这是一个愿意以非常恶毒的方式去对付任何背叛他的人的人。

sentences.en: And then, you know, there's other motivations for him to want to remain in the fold,
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，他还有其他留在圈子里的动机，

sentences.en: including just the emotional one of having spent two-thirds of his entire life in this Trump family business, you know,
sentences.zh: 包括仅仅是情感上的原因，因为他一生中三分之二的时间都在这个特朗普家族企业里度过，你知道，

sentences.en: starting from 50 years ago with Trump's father and when you're in your 20s.
sentences.zh: 从50年前他20多岁时开始为特朗普的父亲工作。

sentences.en: And so it's not natural to want to abandon someone that has basically been like a family to him for half a century.
sentences.zh: 所以，想要抛弃一个半个世纪以来对他来说就像家人一样的人，是不自然的。

sentences.en: And for now, Weisselberg is not cooperating, and he has resisted incredible pressure from prosecutors to do that.
sentences.zh: 目前，魏塞尔伯格没有合作，他抵制了检察官施加的巨大压力。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: He's pleaded not guilty.
sentences.zh: 他拒不认罪。

sentences.en: But let's assume for a moment that Weisselberg does cooperate, does flip.
sentences.zh: 但让我们假设一下，如果魏塞尔伯格确实合作了，确实倒戈了。

sentences.en: It's a big assumption.
sentences.zh: 这是一个很大的假设。

sentences.en: We have watched a lot of people around Trump cooperate in prosecutions.
sentences.zh: 我们已经看到很多特朗普身边的人在起诉中合作了。

sentences.en: You mentioned Michael Cohen.
sentences.zh: 你提到了迈克尔·科恩。

sentences.en: There's also Michael Flynn in the Russia investigation.
sentences.zh: 还有俄罗斯调查中的迈克尔·弗林。

sentences.en: And it never seems that that cooperation ever really hurts Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 而且这种合作似乎从未真正伤害到唐纳德·特朗普。

sentences.en: And I wonder how strong a possibility that is in this case, that Allen Weisselberg could, in Trump's verbiage, become a rat,
sentences.zh: 我想知道在这种情况下，艾伦·魏塞尔伯格用特朗普的话说成为“告密者”的可能性有多大，

sentences.en: and it still wouldn't end up making Donald Trump suffer.
sentences.zh: 而这最终仍然不会让唐纳德·特朗普受到伤害。

sentences.en: Well, all of the history to date would suggest that Donald Trump still would potentially be able to escape any personal consequences
sentences.zh: 嗯，迄今为止的所有历史都表明，唐纳德·特朗普仍然有可能逃脱任何个人后果，

sentences.en: because, I mean, he's been doing that for decades.
sentences.zh: 因为，我是说，他几十年来一直都在这样做。

sentences.en: You know, after crossing lines and having some people turn against him, he has kept his hands clean.
sentences.zh: 你知道，在越界并让一些人背叛他之后，他一直保持着清白。

sentences.en: And his fixers are the ones that go down for him rather than him personally.
sentences.zh: 而他的“清道夫”是那些为他顶罪的人，而不是他本人。

sentences.en: And he's done that very effectively.
sentences.zh: 他非常有效地做到了这一点。

sentences.en: But if anyone were to be able to damage Donald Trump, Allen Weisselberg might just be the guy.
sentences.zh: 但如果有人能伤害到唐纳德·特朗普，艾伦·魏塞尔伯格可能就是那个人。

sentences.en: I mean, you know, money is Donald Trump's, his lifeblood.
sentences.zh: 我是说，你知道，金钱是唐纳德·特朗普的命脉。

sentences.en: And Allen Weisselberg is the guy in charge of the money.
sentences.zh: 而艾伦·魏塞尔伯格就是那个管钱的人。

sentences.en: So if there's anyone who knows where the bodies are buried, Allen Weisselberg is the person.
sentences.zh: 所以如果有人知道尸体埋在哪里，那个人就是艾伦·魏塞尔伯格。

sentences.en: So he is, I think, probably more of a threat than anybody has ever been to Donald Trump if he were to choose to help the prosecutors.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为，如果他选择帮助检察官，他对比以往任何人都更可能成为唐纳德·特朗普的威胁。

sentences.en: So if there's an underlying crime, which we don't know that there is, but if there is an underlying crime,
sentences.zh: 所以如果存在潜在的犯罪行为——我们尚不确定是否存在，但如果确实存在，

sentences.en: you're saying Weisselberg could be the one cooperating witness, if he chooses to cooperate,
sentences.zh: 你的意思是，如果魏塞尔伯格选择合作，他可能会是那个合作证人，

sentences.en: who could defy this history and could actually implicate Trump and ensure he's held accountable.
sentences.zh: 他能够打破这种历史，真正牵连到特朗普，并确保他被追究责任。

sentences.en: I think that's right.
sentences.zh: 我想是这样的。

sentences.en: So for the prospect of Donald Trump being prosecuted after decades of escaping any consequences for many things,
sentences.zh: 因此，对于唐纳德·特朗普在逃避了数十年的各种后果之后可能面临起诉的前景，

sentences.en: we're going to find out whether somebody finally is able to lay a hand on Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 我们将拭目以待，看看是否终于有人能够制裁唐纳德·特朗普。

sentences.en: Well, thank you, Michael.
sentences.zh: 好的，谢谢你，迈克尔。

sentences.en: We appreciate it.
sentences.zh: 我们很感激。

sentences.en: My pleasure.
sentences.zh: 这是我的荣幸。

sentences.en: On Monday night, The Times reported that the Trump Organization has begun removing Allen Weisselberg
sentences.zh: 周一晚上，《纽约时报》报道称，特朗普集团已开始将艾伦·魏塞尔伯格

sentences.en: from every leadership position he had held within dozens of the company's subsidiaries.
sentences.zh: 从他在公司数十家子公司中担任的所有领导职务上撤下。

sentences.en: The move appeared to be an acknowledgement by the Trump family that it was untenable for Weisselberg to hold those positions while facing criminal charges.
sentences.zh: 此举似乎是特朗普家族的一种承认，即魏塞尔伯格在面临刑事指控的同时继续担任这些职务是站不住脚的。

sentences.en: But it was unclear whether or how the decision might influence Weisselberg's thinking about cooperating with prosecutors.
sentences.zh: 但目前尚不清楚这一决定是否会影响，以及如何影响魏塞尔伯格关于与检察官合作的想法。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要了解的其他新闻。

sentences.en: On Monday, President Biden called on the government of Cuba to heed the demands of thousands of demonstrators
sentences.zh: 周一，拜登总统呼吁古巴政府倾听数千名示威者的诉求，

sentences.en: who took to the country's streets on Sunday to protest power outages, food shortages, and a lack of medicine.
sentences.zh: 他们周日走上街头，抗议停电、食品短缺和药品匮乏。

sentences.en: The protests are Cuba's largest in 30 years and represent open defiance of the country's communist government.
sentences.zh: 这些抗议活动是古巴30年来规模最大的抗议，代表了对该国共产主义政府的公开反抗。

sentences.en: The Times reports that the protests were touched off by an economic crisis.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》报道称，这些抗议活动是由经济危机引发的。

sentences.en: The pandemic has largely cut off tourism to Cuba, a crucial source of revenue and employment, leaving its citizens increasingly desperate.
sentences.zh: 疫情在很大程度上切断了古巴的旅游业，而旅游业是其重要的收入和就业来源，这让古巴公民愈发绝望。

sentences.en: And in another setback for Johnson & Johnson's COVID-19 vaccine, the FDA plans to introduce a new warning that it can lead to an increased risk of a rare neurological condition.
sentences.zh: 在强生新冠疫苗遭遇的又一次挫折中，美国食品药品监督管理局（FDA）计划发布一项新警告，称该疫苗可能导致一种罕见神经系统疾病的风险增加。

sentences.en: The condition, known as Guillain-Barre syndrome, involves the immune system attacking nerves.
sentences.zh: 这种疾病被称为格林-巴利综合征，涉及免疫系统攻击神经。

sentences.en: Still, the risk appears to be low.
sentences.zh: 不过，这种风险似乎很低。

sentences.en: The CDC says that after the administration of nearly 13 million doses of J&J's vaccine in the U.S., there have been about 100 suspected cases of the syndrome.
sentences.zh: 美国疾控中心（CDC）表示，在美国接种了近1300万剂强生疫苗后，仅出现了约100例疑似该综合征的病例。

sentences.en: Today's episode was produced by Rachel Quester, Nina Pawtuck, and Rob Zipko.
sentences.zh: 今天的节目由瑞秋·奎斯特、妮娜·帕图克和罗布·齐普科制作。

sentences.en: It was edited by Dave Shaw, contains original music by Dan Powell and Marian Lozano, and was engineered by Chris Wood.
sentences.zh: 由戴夫·肖编辑，包含丹·鲍威尔和玛丽安·洛萨诺的原创音乐，并由克里斯·伍德负责工程制作。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 以上就是《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: This week on The Wirecutter Show, we're getting ready for hosting over the holidays.
sentences.zh: 本周的《Wirecutter秀》节目，我们将为假期接待客人做准备。

sentences.en: Tune in for tips on making your guests feel at home.
sentences.zh: 敬请收听，获取让客人宾至如归的秘诀。

sentences.en: Are they a blackout sleeper?
sentences.zh: 他们是需要全黑环境才能入睡的人吗？

sentences.en: I don't mean do they black out to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我不是指他们是不是喝醉了才睡着。

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require?
sentences.zh: 我是说，他们需要什么样的光线环境？

sentences.en: Because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 因为这是一个非常具体的问题。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们有过敏症或食物敏感吗？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们喝咖啡还是喝茶？

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢几点起床？

sentences.en: Find The Wirecutter Show on The New York Times app or wherever you like to listen.
sentences.zh: 你可以在《纽约时报》应用程序或你喜欢的任何播客平台找到《Wirecutter秀》。
